faqs.a: Onairo Solutions is a technology company with four pillars: Build (client services — websites, software, automation, AI), Launch (industry websites), Scale (commercial products like EduTrack and FitTrack), and Sell (Shopify store design and launch).

faqs.q: How long does a website take?
faqs.a: Most business websites launch in 7–14 days depending on scope and content readiness.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Published starting packages: Starter from $150, Business from $350, Premium from $650. These are indicative starting prices — final quotes depend on pages, features, and content.

faqs.q: How much does custom software cost?
faqs.a: Custom software is quoted after understanding requirements. There is no one-size published price.
